messages.subject: tidyLPA package compare solutions command
parts:
Dear Dr. Rosenberg,

 

first, thank you very much for programming the tidyLPA package, as well as your other packages!

They make my life as a PhD student much more exciting, as they enable me to use more complex methods.  

 

I was working with tidyLPA today and was not able to replicate the BIC values displayed in the compare_solutions plot with the estimate profiles command.

For example, the BIC values for the solution with 2 profiles were the following:

  • 2 Profiles, Model 1, compare_solutions: around 24600
  • 2 Profiles, Model 2, compare_solutions: around 24960
  • 2 Profiles, Model 1, estimate profiles: 24960
  • 2 Profiles, Model 2, estimate profiles: 24960

The same pattern occurs for the solutions with other numbers of profiles, here the calculations I made for the solution with just one profile:

 

As I am not that firm with programming, I cannot check for myself if I have made some mistakes or if there could be a small bug for example in the legend for the compare_solutions plot, or in the estimate profiles command.

 

I would be very thankful if you could help me. Thanks in advance for your time and effort.

 

Kind regards from Germany,  

 

Fiona Rupprecht

 

 

 

Fiona Rupprecht, M. Sc.

PhD Student

Institute for Psychogerontology

University of Erlangen-Nuremberg
